seoTitle: Connect HF | Your Sourcing Partner for Products Made in India
seoDescription: Connect HF connects international buyers with vetted Tamil Nadu manufacturers and suppliers across India. Commission-based sourcing and coordination intermediary.

hero.subtitle: We help importers, brands, and procurement teams source directly from India. Tell us what you need — we'll handle the complete procurement process end to end, from supplier sourcing to logistics.

categoriesSection.title: Explore Products We Can Help Source
categoriesSection.subtitle: Explore core manufacturing sectors across Tamil Nadu clusters. We coordinate sourcing briefs directly with verified suppliers.

valueProp.title: Our Role as Sourcing & Coordination Intermediary
valueProp.subtitle: We bridge international buyers and regional manufacturers through transparent communication and disciplined coordination.
valueProp.item1Text: A focused network across Tamil Nadu manufacturing clusters including Tiruppur, Coimbatore, Chennai, Ambur, Pollachi and Salem.
valueProp.item2Text: We help identify suitable manufacturers based on your detailed technical specifications and compliance expectations.
valueProp.item3Text: Consolidating commercial quotations and sample requests so communication remains structured, clear and timely.
valueProp.item4Text: Commission-based coordination intermediary. Buyers contract directly with verified manufacturers without hidden retail markups.
valueProp.item5Text: Assisting with commercial invoices, packing lists and factory liaison through major logistics ports like Chennai and Tuticorin.
